scope: Independent static prefit admission review of the committed focused lock, complete potential-unit registry, role and source custody, resource limits, and M5 replay readiness. This is not a numerical Adult result or a competitive claim.

resource_review.interpretation: The 628-unit registry is a superset. The frozen selected-run upper bound of 30,180 seconds is below the 36,000-second wall ceiling; all 628 potential units are not scheduled together.

m5_pair_role_sized_partial_synthetic.limit: This smoke did not restore validation packages; the 120-second pair cap also uses the prior sealed S4 C replay timing of 1.98 to 3.00 seconds as supporting evidence.

m5_replay_readiness.source_independence: M5 replay reconstructs the M1 public capacity bank and computes endpoints, control selection, and the 207-clause simultaneous interval family without importing M2/M3 selector or M4 scorer implementations.
m5_replay_readiness.aggregate_dependency: The static aggregate specification depends on the M4 endpoint and M3 inference units; the M5 aggregate worker additionally requires the point-selected M5 pair replay units and their two hash-bound outputs to be DONE before it emits a PASS report.

conditions_for_real_execution: M0 must commit a local seal binding this review SHA, the exact committed lock SHA and commit, and the private registry SHA before queue admission.

The shared compute queue must apply the sealed unit registry, single focused slot, one-thread environment, role allowlist, resource caps, and no-child-process OS limit at launch and before each worker reads a role file.
M5 pair replays must complete for the selected pairs before either M5 aggregate is enqueued; conditional finalist seed 2 follows the frozen screen rule.
All resulting findings remain development-only because the Adult roles were exposed in the prior portfolio and no new confirmation population is present.
